pipeline: Approved ImageGen concept, Meshy 6 image-to-3D and auto-rig, then Blender 4.5 browser preparation and authored locomotion

prototypes.name: The Pale Maw
prototypes.visualNotes: A chalk-pale, eyeless four-point crawler with a split vertical mouth, raised shoulder blades, long independently skinned arms, a low wide crouch, reverse-jointed leg read, and black claws. The runtime model preserves the accepted default processed bind without hips, neck, head, arm, or lateral reshaping.

animationNotes.idle: The accepted default processed bind remains unchanged through the torso, shoulders, neck, and head while inward elbow poles keep both front joints near the body and all four weighted surfaces settle on the floor.
animationNotes.walk: The left hand plants with the right foot and the right hand with the left foot; inward elbow poles narrow the front silhouette while compensated palm rotations preserve supported contact without changing the default body or head pose.
animationNotes.run: The faster diagonal contact-push cycle preserves the tucked front-elbow plane, planted palm orientation, default body/head bind, and skin-deformation guard.

prototypes.name: The Banquet Saint
prototypes.visualNotes: A tall ceremonial figure with a blank porcelain mask, narrow black smile, crown-like cage, aged metal breastplate, oxblood brocade, and long skeletal hands.

animationNotes.idle: The forward-facing bind pose holds both knees and elbows straight while the arms share a slight synchronized pendulum drift.
animationNotes.walk: Root translation creates the ceremonial ground glide; the locked legs remain still and both straight arms hang behind travel as one restrained pendulum.
animationNotes.run: The faster QA clip preserves the same forward-facing locked posture and symmetric rearward pendulum.
